Artist.value: NASA/Apollo 17 crew; taken by either Harrison Schmitt or Ron Evans

ImageDescription.value: "The Blue Marble" is a famous photograph of the Earth taken on December 7, 1972, by the crew of the Apollo 17 spacecraft en route to the Moon at a distance of about 29,400 kilometres (18,300 mi). It shows Africa, Antarctica, and the Arabian Peninsula.
